search_window.basis: Since preceding verified hourly supplementary Care Line watch completion; preceding publication dates considered for late-indexed recall candidates.

coverage_notes.scope: Bounded supplementary U.S., District of Columbia, and territories access-loss/restoration recall. Primary national Care Line production collector remains authoritative.

coverage_notes.findings_note: No newly verified and nonduplicate qualifying healthcare-access event emerged from the bounded research. Search results were overwhelmingly old, overseas or without concrete service change.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Excluded older events, overseas stories, predictions or proposed changes without effective access consequences, business-only material, opinion, and earlier watch cases.
coverage_notes.limitations: Targeted search results often returned older material despite recency constraints. Not an exhaustive national survey; no source/tool failures identified in the completed 12 searches. CMS Public Notices and preceding ledger heartbeat were accessible.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, production collection changes, schedule modifications, or task disabling.
